description: Change the name, icon, or linked course of an existing project. Pass course_id null to unlink the course.

course_id.description: Positive integer course id from search-courses, or null to unlink the course. Example: 1581710. Omit to leave the link unchanged.

emoji.description: New icon text, usually an emoji. Example: "📚". Omit to leave it unchanged.

project_id.description: UUID of the project to change. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. From create-project or get-context.

title.description: New name, 1-255 characters, with at least one non-space character. Example: "Biology midterm". Omit to leave the name unchanged.

name: update-project

project_id.description: UUID string in 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal form. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.

title.description: Agent-displayable project title. Null Alpha names become "Untitled project".

title: Update Studocu Project
